info.title: dotnet-gitversion
info.description: Derives SemVer information from a repository following GitFlow or GitHubFlow. This is the .NET Core Global Tool allowing usage of GitVersion from command line.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Use convention to derive a SemVer product version from a GitFlow or GitHub based repository.

options.name: --diagnose
options.description:
Runs GitVersion with additional diagnostic information.
Also needs the '--log-file' argument to specify a logfile or stdout (requires git.exe to be installed)

options.name: --log-file
options.description: Path to logfile; specify 'console' to emit to stderr

options.name: --output
options.description: Determines the output to the console. Can be either 'json', 'file', 'buildserver' or 'dotenv', will default to 'json'

options.name: --output-file
options.description: Path to output file. It is used in combination with --output 'file'

options.name: --show-variable
options.description:
Used in conjunction with --output json, will output just a particular variable.
E.g. --output json --show-variable SemVer - will output `1.2.3+beta.4`

options.name: --format
options.description:
Used in conjunction with --output json, will output a format containing version variables.
Supports C# format strings - see [Format Strings](/docs/reference/custom-formatting) for details.
E.g. --output json --format {SemVer} - will output `1.2.3+beta.4`
--output json --format {Major}.{Minor} - will output `1.2`

options.name: --no-fetch
options.description: Disables 'git fetch' during version calculation. Might cause GitVersion to not calculate your version as expected

options.name: --no-cache
options.description: Bypasses the cache, result will not be written to the cache

options.name: --no-normalize
options.description: Disables normalize step on a build server

options.name: --allow-shallow
options.description:
Allows GitVersion to run on a shallow clone.
This is not recommended, but can be used if you are sure that the shallow clone contains all the information needed to calculate the version.

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: Specifies the amount of information to be displayed (Quiet, Minimal, Normal, Verbose, Diagnostic). Default is Normal

options.name: --update-assembly-info
options.description: Will recursively search for all 'AssemblyInfo.cs' files in the git repo and update them

options.name: --update-project-files
options.description: Will recursively search for all project files (.csproj/.vbproj/.fsproj/.sqlproj) in the git repo and update them (only compatible with Sdk projects)

options.name: --ensure-assembly-info
options.description:
If the assembly info file specified with --update-assembly-info is not found, it will be created with AssemblyFileVersion, AssemblyVersion and AssemblyInformationalVersion.
Supports C#, F#, VB
